# Hues and Cues — The Colourful Word Game

> Hues and Cues is a free browser party game: one player gives a one-word clue for a target colour and the other players guess which colour on the board matches it.

Canonical: https://furkankoykiran.com.tr/hues-and-cues/
Source: https://github.com/furkankoykiran/hues-and-cues
Languages: English (en), Turkish (tr)
License: MIT

## What it is

Hues and Cues is a digital adaptation of the colour-guessing board game. The board is a grid of
colours. The active player sees a target colour and says a single word that describes it — without
naming a colour or a number. Everyone else picks the square they think matches the clue, and the
closer the pick, the more points the round is worth.

## How to play

1. Open https://furkankoykiran.com.tr/hues-and-cues/.
2. Choose the number of teams (1–8) and start the game.
3. The active player reads the hidden target colour and gives a one-word clue.
4. The other players pick a colour on the board; the round scores by distance to the target.
5. Repeat until the scoreboard picks a winner.

## Features

- One-word clue rounds with automatic distance-based scoring
- 1 to 8 teams, including a solo mode
- Light and dark themes
- English and Turkish interface with a language picker
- No account, no tracking and no backend
